summary: Completed backend + frontend testing for practice video assignment workflow (upload, scoped delivery, viewed state, edit/delete, privacy, and regressions). Backend pytest suite for practice-video APIs passed (4/4). Frontend e2e verified staff publish/edit/watch/delete, parent notification + read state, mobile navigation/overflow, and parent/staff/admin login route regressions.

minor.issue: Global privacy middleware rewrites Cache-Control to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate', overriding route-specific cache headers (public media route cannot return intended public cache header, and private media route cannot return intended 'private, no-store').

ui_bugs.issue: Browser console shows hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' while rendering dropdown options.

action_items: Preserve route-specific Cache-Control headers instead of overriding all responses in middleware (or conditionally skip for media routes).
Investigate and fix option-rendering hydration warning in staff practice dropdown to avoid invalid HTML nesting.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py middleware sets Cache-Control for all responses, which unintentionally negates explicit per-route caching/privacy intent in public.py and practice.py media routes.
Practice components are well covered with data-testid attributes for core interactions (upload/publish/edit/watch/delete/read-state).
seed_data_creation: Created synthetic demo practice videos during backend/frontend tests. UI create-delete flow was explicitly verified and cleaned in that run; backend test runs created records inside isolated demo sandboxes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_practice_videos.py for regression. For UI, keep staff and parent switches inside the same browser context to preserve mnc_demo sandbox cookie. Admin overview selectors are numeric (admin-stat-0..3).
rca of the issue: Cache header mismatch RCA: privacy middleware in server.py always rewrites Cache-Control after route handlers return, so media routes cannot enforce their own route-level policy. Repro: request /api/public/media/{valid_path} or /api/practice-videos/{id}/media and inspect response headers; expected per-route Cache-Control is replaced by middleware value. Mitigation: conditionally skip Cache-Control rewrite when response already sets a policy, or apply path-based exceptions for media endpoints.
